_note: THE IDENTITY CORE (handoff 2026-07-25 §3.2, §4.1 'Text -> me in a scene' = MAIN ROUTE). Text-to-image likeness: SDXL builds the person from scratch, conditioned by the Carey SDXL LoRA plus IP-Adapter FaceID on a REAL ground-truth photo. This is structurally different from the face-zone lane: here the output's facial GEOMETRY comes from the identity, not from a target image. The mesh-seed zone lane warps Carey through the TARGET's 478-point grid, so its output geometry is always the target's and only colour transfers — which is why it produced recolours (2026-07-22 Vegeta). Use this recipe for likeness; use the zone lane for surgical edits on an existing picture, never for likeness.

identity._note: The SDXL model pack for this subject. Resolved by byrdimage at submit time; the recipe carries it so the identity lane can never run unconditioned because nobody typed a filename. Replace with the promoted SDXL pack once it passes the §11.1 scorecard (>=80/100).

reference_policy._rule: Camera photos only (profile references.ground_truth). Never condition identity on generated/anime support material.

template: {shot} of a man, {expression}, {wardrobe}, {setting}, {lighting}, {style}, sharp detailed facial features, natural skin texture, high detail
negative: text, letters, words, watermark, blurry, low quality, deformed face, distorted features, extra limbs, mutated hands, plastic skin, waxy, airbrushed, different person, mask, cgi doll

setting.label: Setting / scene (e.g. neon Tokyo street at night)

wardrobe.default: a black bomber jacket over a plain tee
wardrobe.label: Wardrobe

style.default: cinematic photography, 85mm, shallow depth of field
style.label: Style

lighting: soft key light with warm rim

rubric.identity: 1-5 — is this immediately recognizable as the same person as the REAL reference photos, at normal viewing size (not only zoomed)?
rubric.face_integrity: 1-5 — eyes, mouth, jaw, ears, hair and skin coherent; no melting, no doubled features
rubric.realism: 1-5 — natural skin texture and lighting; not plastic or airbrushed
rubric.scene_quality: 1-5 — composition, lighting and setting read as intentional
